newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers gain, rest of Europe dips.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers gain, rest of Europe dips.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers rose $1/$2 a tonne on Wednesday, while prices in the rest of Europe softened, in a reverse of Tuesday's pattern, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at $84.50/$85 fob after barges pushed past $82 ex-wharf.
Total ARA volume was reasonable, but still disappointed suppliers who hoped for business ahead of wide-spread European holidays on Thursday and expected thin activity on Friday.
Hamburg bunkers were slightly weaker. Business was fairly lively which most suppliers attributed to tomorrow's holiday.
Mediterranean prices were mostly $1 a tonne softer.
Trading volumes were mixed. France, which is not working on Thursday, was busy, but much of the rest of the Med countries, which will be in business, were quiet.
In Fujairah, fuel oil bunkers rose by $1 in response to the gain in Singapore, further discouraging tanker owners who prefer to refuel in the more competitive Europe or North America markets.
